expectations.text: Identifies QC 1000 as the PCAOB quality control standard taking effect December 15, 2026
expectations.evidence: "QC 1000, 'A Firm's System of Quality Control,' is the PCAOB standard... It takes effect December 15, 2026."

expectations.text: Describes the September 9, 2026 amendments: rescinded the design-only requirement and the External QC Function requirement, and let firms choose their annual evaluation date
expectations.evidence: "The PCAOB adopted targeted amendments on September 9, 2026. They rescind the design-only requirement and the External QC Function requirement, and they let firms choose their annual evaluation date."

expectations.text: States the SEC approved the amendments on November 2, 2026 with the effective date unchanged
expectations.evidence: "The SEC approved those amendments on November 2, 2026, and the effective date is unchanged."

expectations.text: Explains it governs audit firms' quality control systems, so it affects the auditor rather than imposing direct issuer obligations
expectations.evidence: "QC 1000 binds your auditor, not you. Management's 404(a) assessment, your RCM and your ITGCs are unaffected."

expectations.text: Advises discussing with the auditor how QC 1000 affects the 2026 year-end audit
expectations.evidence: "Ask the engagement partner in writing: how is the firm applying QC 1000 to this engagement, and have the timetable, PBC list or sample expectations changed?"
